en: A black-and-white image depicting a row of elegant 19th-century buildings along a narrow river or canal, with forested hills rising steeply in the background. The buildings have ornate facades, large windows, and awnings. Several signs are visible on the buildings, including names such as 'DREI STAFFELN', 'CARL BRUNN', 'STRAUSS', and 'NASTOPIL'. The setting suggests a prominent European spa or resort town, with tree-lined streets and a promenade.
